fieldValues.title: The handbook says things that are no longer true
fieldValues.statement: The one document that says how the programme runs is written by hand beside code and records that change daily, so within a day it describes practice that no longer exists and people and agents act on a stale picture.
source_ref: clerk#50 (2026-10-11): the handbook was edited eight times on 2026-10-11 and was stale by evening
